records.title: OpenAI Codex CLI Interface & Headless Execution Specification
records.claim_scope: Headless CLI execution semantics, workspace flags, approval behaviors, and JSON streaming protocols.
records.notes: Core documentation for OpenAI Codex CLI headless execution, JSON streaming output, and workspace binding.

records.title: AGENTS.md Specification and Downward Hierarchy Protocol
records.claim_scope: AGENTS.md file discovery, directory scoping, inheritance, and downward precedence resolution.
records.notes: Specifies directory-level agent instruction scoping, inheritance rules, and conflict resolution across subdirectories.

records.title: Codex Security, Sandbox Isolation, and Approval Policies
records.claim_scope: Sandbox levels (read-only, workspace-write, danger-full-access), approval configurations, and outbound network boundary constraints.
records.notes: Defines sandbox boundary levels (read-only, workspace-write, danger-full-access) and network egress restrictions.

records.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
records.claim_scope: Evaluation methodology for autonomous software engineering agents resolving GitHub defects under test harnesses.
records.notes: Defines the standard methodology for evaluating autonomous software engineering agents on real-world repository defects.

records.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
records.claim_scope: Episodic memory, dynamic test repair loops, and self-reflection mechanics in code generation agents.
records.notes: Theoretical and empirical foundation for self-reflection loops, episodic memory, and dynamic test repair in coding agents.

records.title: Evaluating Large Language Models Trained on Code (HumanEval)
records.claim_scope: pass@k metric definitions and isolated function-level code synthesis evaluation baselines.
records.notes: Foundational code synthesis evaluation dataset introducing pass@k metrics for model-generated function completions.

records.title: Monorepo Context Starvation & Compaction Loss in Coding Agents
records.claim_scope: Practitioner qualitative report of degraded rule compliance in large monolithic instruction files.
records.notes: Community discussion observing reduced command adherence when monolithic AGENTS.md files exceed recommended token budgets.

records.title: Prompt Bloat vs Dynamic Skill Invocation in Long-Running Workflows
records.claim_scope: Practitioner observations on context preservation when offloading procedures to on-demand skills.
records.notes: Community forum thread discussing advantages of packaging procedural instructions as on-demand skills rather than continuous system prompt bloat.

records.title: Developer Approval Fatigue and Safe Automation Boundaries
records.claim_scope: Practitioner qualitative analysis of security degradation caused by frequent approval modal prompts.
records.notes: Field observation regarding reflexive approvals when interactive permission dialogues exceed ergonomic thresholds.

records.title: CAE Deterministic Benchmark Suite v1: Golden Reference vs Buggy Baselines
records.claim_scope: Empirical validation that golden reference implementations pass 100% of adversarial suites while buggy baselines are 100% detected. Agent evaluation is unestablished without local Codex CLI.
records.notes: Deterministic benchmark across 5 core failure modes (deadlock, SQL injection, async leak, race condition, schema migration). Live agent evaluation layer is structured but marked skipped when Codex binary is absent.

records.title: Codex Agent Engineering Architectural Decision Ledger & Governance
records.claim_scope: Architectural invariants, walking skeleton decisions, and AI-DLC lifecycle specifications.
records.notes: Primary architectural decisions, walking skeleton invariants, and AI-DLC memory for codex-agent-engineering maintainers.
